title: High Draw Call & SetPass Call count causing CPU render bottleneck
symptoms: CPU rendering thread time increases when many small objects are visible
causes: Multiple unique materials and individual un-batched textures
Lack of Sprite Atlases for 2D/UI elements

solution.action: Pack 2D sprites and UI graphics into unified Sprite Atlases.
Enable GPU Instancing or Static Batching on meshes sharing identical materials.

prevention: Keep total mobile draw calls within 100-150 binned calls.
